narrative: A small shop-ticket on the chamber table, creased from a sleeve, no new figures added. The door is shut. The same ticket, two lines under the first. The sums are still unwritten. The foot of the ticket, a short line, and clean paper under it. No second hand has touched it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the three shops and the near total, and wrote no new figure.

entities.name: Gilbert's shop-ticket
entities.context: Shown on bill in The ticket in the sleeve
